answer: Operator-Linked Identity Bridge. Each new wallet derives its identity key from an operator-held umber secret plus a coarse time bucket, so one operator cannot mint unlimited independent identities without re-deriving keys. Enforcement: if two identities sharing an operator secret ever transact with each other or with a flagged cluster, the operator's quartz deposit posted at bridge registration is slashed proportionally. This punishes the operator, not the wallets.
